**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως εἶδον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῇ ὁράσει καὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ’ αὐτῶν, ἔχοντας θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἵππων ὡς κεφαλαὶ λεόντων, καὶ ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν ἐκπορεύεται πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον.

beats: 9:15 Four angels loosed—prepared for the hour, day, month, year—to kill one-third of humanity.
9:16 The cavalry's number: two myriads of myriads; I heard their count.
9:17 Horses seen in vision, riders bearing breastplates of fire, hyacinth, brimstone; horses' heads like lions' heads; from mouths issue fire, smoke, sulfur.

slot_map.ἐλύθησαν (were loosed): their debt came due / were foreclosed upon
slot_map.οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι: four expenditures / four costs held in escrow
slot_map.εἶδον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῇ ὁράσει: I witnessed the mounts in the invoice-vision
slot_map.τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ' αὐτῶν: those borne upon them / those indebted to them
slot_map.ὑακινθίνους: bruise-blue / the color of spent flesh
slot_map.θειώδεις: sulfurous / residue of what was consumed
slot_map.ὡς κεφαλαὶ λεόντων: like the heads of creditors / devourers
slot_map.πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον: fire (the price), smoke (the receipt), sulfur (the remainder)

layer_b_declaration.axis: Every temporal coordinate is a cost-maturation; destruction is collection on a compounding debt.
layer_b_declaration.foreclosure: The source forecloses against time as neutral measure—hour, day, month, year are always already prices accruing.
layer_b_declaration.wager: Preparation (ἡτοιμασμένοι) is not readiness but compounding—waiting itself is the usury.
layer_b_declaration.affect: Dread of discovering that the schedule you inhabit is an invoice addressed to you.

independent_verification.recovered_law: The apocalyptic military destruction (angels released to kill, cavalry armies, war-horses breathing fire) is re-mapped onto a financial/debt domain (debts accumulated to exact payment, usury expenses, creditors pouring out interest and ruin), changing the agents from supernatural warriors to economic oppressors and the action from killing to debt-collection.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: divine military agents become financial/debt entities, sovereign destruction becomes debt collection, and the cavalry/angels shift from supernatural warriors to creditors—the recovered claim captures the core relational remapping declared.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The financial/debt relation persists through 9:17, with creditors, usury imagery, and economic destruction replacing horses, lions, and fire throughout.

advisories.diagnosis: witness-question entities inside the transform or commentary: hour

rotation.commentary: The scene pays for its own duration: every unit of time that passed in silence was not patience but compounding, and the vision's terror is not that force arrives but that the bill was always growing, and what the mouths pour out is not fire but what fire was always a figure for — the remainder that cannot be returned.

9:16 Number of cavalry armies: two myriads of myriads; I heard their number.

layer_b_declaration.axis: The expected temporal answer (the hour, the day) is structurally withheld, and the scene re-derives around its absence.
layer_b_declaration.foreclosure: The source forecloses indeterminacy: the angels are prepared for THE hour, THE day — precision is the scaffold of destruction.
layer_b_declaration.wager: The cost is enduring a mobilization that cannot locate its appointed moment and therefore cannot discharge its violence.
layer_b_declaration.affect: Dread suspended into a permanence worse than arrival — readiness without release, an army that cannot find its war.

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A the four angels are released (ἐλύθησαν) and actively accomplish their purpose — killing a third of mankind — with destructive force (fire, smoke, brimstone from lion-headed horses). In Text B the angels remain/stay (ἔμενον) unreleased, their killing has no received object (no third or portion of mankind accepts them), and the horses emit only inert residues (mist, breath, darkness from ox-heads): agency and effectual destruction are replaced by stasis, refusal, and emptiness.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both identify a transformation from active destructive release to permanent stasis/non-discharge, but the declared claim focuses specifically on the removal of the temporal coordinate (hour/day/month/year) as the structural mechanism, while the recovered claim focuses on the replacement of release with staying (ἐλύθησαν→ἔμενον), removal of the object of killing, and transformation of destructive emissions into inert residues — overlapping in the stasis/non-discharge outcome but differing in the specific structural mechanism identified.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B sustains the changed relation: destructive agency is consistently replaced with inert, muted, ineffectual imagery (ash-colored breastplates, ox-heads, mist/breath/darkness) throughout.

law_variance.declared: In the source the temporal coordinate (hour/day/month/year) is the sufficient cause that authorizes angelic release and destruction flows outward from that authorization. In the transformed world the coordinate is structurally absent: the angels are prepared but there is no hour to be loosed INTO; preparation becomes a permanent state without discharge. The cavalry exists but its violence has no temporal address to arrive at. The event transforms from a punctual destruction into an interminable mobilization — the army is the cost of an answer that was never given, and the witness absorbs the silence where the number of the hour was owed, as one who heard their count but never heard their moment.
law_variance.recovered: In Text A the four angels are released (ἐλύθησαν) and actively accomplish their purpose — killing a third of mankind — with destructive force (fire, smoke, brimstone from lion-headed horses). In Text B the angels remain/stay (ἔμενον) unreleased, their killing has no received object (no third or portion of mankind accepts them), and the horses emit only inert residues (mist, breath, darkness from ox-heads): agency and effectual destruction are replaced by stasis, refusal, and emptiness.
law_variance.note: Both identify a transformation from active destructive release to permanent stasis/non-discharge, but the declared claim focuses specifically on the removal of the temporal coordinate (hour/day/month/year) as the structural mechanism, while the recovered claim focuses on the replacement of release with staying (ἐλύθησαν→ἔμενον), removal of the object of killing, and transformation of destructive emissions into inert residues — overlapping in the stasis/non-discharge outcome but differing in the specific structural mechanism identified.

rotation.commentary: The cavalry stands forever harnessed, oxen circling a millstone with no grain; the witness's burden is not destruction witnessed but the count of an army whose summons never arrived, heard as a number inside a silence that will not end.
